non_vital_summary: Scouting calls explored table schemas, output events, trach/chest tube history, skin assessments, lung sounds, edema, stool/GI findings, and browsed web for phenotype definitions. Most were exploratory or confirmatory without yielding decisive new evidence.

reasoning_failure_analysis.where_it_went_wrong: The reasoning model only saw the last 80 chart events (mostly recent vitals near discharge) and the CXR. It lacked earlier vital signs showing fevers/hypotension, lab values (lactate, WBC, albumin, electrolytes), vancomycin levels, and the HCUP CCS phenotype vocabulary. It defaulted to radiographic findings only.
reasoning_failure_analysis.missed_evidence: Earlier fevers (40°C), persistent MAP<65, vancomycin treatment, lab values (lactate, electrolytes, albumin), ostomy/surgical history, and the 25 HCUP CCS phenotype category names were all absent from the curated prompt.
